The tone is dark comedy with a 'brainrot' aesthetic, featuring dramatic camera movements and a tense, cinematic atmosphere.

script_package.title: Jimmy Neutron's Brain Blast Withdrawal: A Roadman Parody
script_package.description: Watch Jimmy Neutron's frantic journey through a neon-lit alley, battling severe 'Brain Blast' withdrawal. Pure urban brainrot comedy!
script_package.spoken_script:
Yo, my head's moving mad, bruv. Need that pure Brain Blast, on my life.
These opps got me vexed, fam. Sweating like I ran a marathon, no cap.
Where's my guy? This ain't no joke. My neurons are doing the electric slide.
I'm twitching like a broken robot, fam. This ain't no finesse, this is a crisis.
He said meet me by the bins, innit? This rain ain't helping my vibe.
My brain's doing somersaults, bruv. I'm seeing double, triple, quad-vision.
Yo, is that him? Finally! My man's moving slow, though. What's the hold-up?
I'm about to go full 'Ultra Lord' on this situation if I don't get my fix.
He better have the good stuff, the high-purity, the proper Brain Blast.
My whole existence depends on this. Don't be washed, fam, don't be washed.
Give it to me! The sweet, sweet knowledge. My brain cells are screaming.
Ah, the Brain Blast! Pure, unadulterated genius. I'm back, baby!

scenes.headline: The Withdrawal Begins
scenes.supporting_text: Rain streaks down his face, reflecting neon. His movements are erratic.
scenes.narration_text: Jimmy Neutron is in deep withdrawal, frantically searching for his 'Brain Blast' fix.
scenes.action_prompt: Close-up on the Uploaded Character (Jimmy Neutron), drenched in rain, eyes wide and darting nervously. He's aggressively scratching his neck and arms, sweat beading on his forehead under the harsh glow of a flickering neon sign. His mouth is slightly agape, muttering to himself. The camera is handheld, slightly shaky, pushing in slowly.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Jimmy: "Yo, my head's moving mad, bruv. Need that pure Brain Blast, on my life. These opps got me vexed, fam. Sweating like I ran a marathon, no cap."
scenes.negative_prompt: clean, calm, well-lit, happy, relaxed, bright colors
scenes.style_notes: Maintain brainrot aesthetic, gritty urban feel, focus on character's distress.
scenes.visual_query: Jimmy Neutron character, severe withdrawal, scratching, sweating, dark rainy alley, neon sign, close-up, handheld camera

scenes.headline: Frantic Search
scenes.supporting_text: He looks over his shoulder constantly. The alley is dimly lit by streetlights.
scenes.narration_text: His desperation grows as he searches, his mind spiraling.
scenes.action_prompt: Medium shot of the Uploaded Character (Jimmy Neutron) frantically pacing and looking around a dark, graffiti-covered alleyway. He's pulling at his clothes, twitching, and occasionally slapping his own head. Rain continues to fall, making the ground slick. A distant, blurry figure can be seen at the end of the alley. The camera whip-pans with his head movements.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Jimmy: "Where's my guy? This ain't no joke. My neurons are doing the electric slide. I'm twitching like a broken robot, fam. This ain't no finesse, this is a crisis. He said meet me by the bins, innit? This rain ain't helping my vibe."
scenes.negative_prompt: peaceful, still, bright daylight, empty street, no character interaction
scenes.camera_style: Medium shot, whip pan, slightly low angle
scenes.style_notes: Emphasize his erratic behavior and the oppressive environment.
scenes.visual_query: Jimmy Neutron character, frantic search, dark alley, graffiti walls, rain, distant figure, medium shot, whip pan

scenes.headline: The Confrontation
scenes.supporting_text: The shadowy figure is barely visible, adding to the mystery. Jimmy's eyes are locked on him.
scenes.narration_text: He finally spots his contact, but the wait is agonizing.
scenes.action_prompt: Low-angle shot of the Uploaded Character (Jimmy Neutron) confronting a shadowy figure (back to camera) by overflowing bins. Jimmy's face is contorted in a mix of anger and desperation, his hands are gesturing wildly. Steam rises from a nearby drain. The shadowy figure remains still, creating tension. The camera pushes in on Jimmy's face.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Jimmy: "My brain's doing somersaults, bruv. I'm seeing double, triple, quad-vision. Yo, is that him? Finally! My man's moving slow, though. What's the hold-up? I'm about to go full 'Ultra Lord' on this situation if I don't get my fix."
scenes.negative_prompt: friendly interaction, open space, no tension, clear view of other character
scenes.camera_style: Low-angle shot, push-in on character's face
scenes.style_notes: Highlight the dramatic tension and Jimmy's aggressive impatience.
scenes.visual_query: Jimmy Neutron character, confronting shadowy figure, dark alley, overflowing bins, low angle, steam, push-in on face

scenes.headline: The Brain Blast Fix
scenes.supporting_text: The vial glows intensely. His transformation is immediate and comical.
scenes.narration_text: The 'Brain Blast' is acquired, and Jimmy is instantly transformed.
scenes.action_prompt: Extreme close-up on the Uploaded Character (Jimmy Neutron)'s hand as he snatches a small, glowing vial (representing 'Brain Blast') from the shadowy figure's hand. His eyes widen with relief and a manic grin spreads across his face. He quickly brings the vial to his mouth, taking a dramatic gulp. A sudden, bright flash of light emanates from the vial as he consumes it. The camera quickly zooms out to a medium shot, showing him standing tall, chest puffed out, completely transformed and confident, the rain still falling but no longer bothering him.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Jimmy: "He better have the good stuff, the high-purity, the proper Brain Blast. My whole existence depends on this. Don't be washed, fam, don't be washed. Give it to me! The sweet, sweet knowledge. My brain cells are screaming. Ah, the Brain Blast! Pure, unadulterated genius. I'm back, baby!"
scenes.negative_prompt: continued withdrawal, sadness, disappointment, subtle change, no visual effect
scenes.camera_style: Extreme close-up, quick zoom out to medium shot
scenes.style_notes: Emphasize the comedic payoff and the instant, over-the-top transformation.
scenes.visual_query: Jimmy Neutron character, extreme close-up hand, glowing vial, dramatic gulp, flash of light, transformation, confident pose, rain, medium shot
